Basis of measurement.   Measured in accordance with the RICS Code of Measuring Practice (6th edition). Net Internal Area
(NIA) excludes stairwells, lift and plant areas, toilets, internal structural walls and areas with headroom below 1.5 m. Gross
Internal Area (GIA) is measured to the internal face of the perimeter walls at each floor level. Conversions use 1 m² = 10.7639 sq
ft; totals are summed in m² and then converted. 
Note to client.   The NIA recorded here (177.6 m² / 1,912 sq ft) is lower than the 185 m² / 1,990 sq ft quoted in current marketing
particulars. The difference arises mainly on the second floor, where we exclude the eaves zone with headroom below 1.5 m and
the plant cupboard. 
Parking.   The rear courtyard is lined for six bays. On the date of survey   five (5) bays (1 to 5) were in use as allocated parking ;
bay 6 is marked as bin store and turning area and was not in use for parking. See drawing HR/26/0917/03. 
Energy Performance Certificate.   For information, the current non-domestic EPC for the building (certificate
9417-3082-6651-2049-7735, dated 2 September 2026) records an asset rating of 58,   band C , and a total useful floor area of
239 m². EPC floor area is calculated on its own basis and is not comparable with the NIA or GIA above.

St Huberts Close, Gerrards Cross 
Specification applicable to all house types A–E unless stated otherwise in the plot schedule (section 4) 
1. Kitchens 
Units   Shaker-style painted units with soft-close hinges; maple-effect option on type E 
Worktops   20 mm quartz with upstand; 1½ bowl stainless steel undermount sink 
Appliances   Integrated oven, combination microwave, induction hob, extractor, fridge-freezer and dishwasher 
2. Bathrooms and en-suites 
Family bathroom   White suite with bath, thermostatic shower over bath and glass screen 
En-suites   All en-suites are fitted with walk-in showers with low-profile trays and glass screens.   Exception:
house type D (see section 4). 
Tiling   Full height to wet areas; half height elsewhere; porcelain floor tiles 
Sanitaryware   Wall-hung WCs with concealed cisterns; chrome fittings throughout 
3. Heating, electrical and external 
Heating   Gas-fired condensing boiler with radiators; underfloor heating to ground floor of types D and E 
Electrical   LED downlights to kitchen and bathrooms; USB sockets to kitchen and bedrooms 
Garaging   Double garage to types C, D and E; single garage to types A and B 
EV charging   7 kW charge point to every garage 
This schedule describes the standard specification for the development. Purchasers should check the plot schedule and the individual property,
as finishes may vary between plots and may have been altered by subsequent owners.
